messages:
maya: Quick sync — final run for Wed webinar (Prod Inference: real traffic case). Can we lock script + lighting + demo fallback? 3842004321
jason: Yep. TL;DR: intros 60s each, demo live 6m, QA 10m. Keep slides to 12. :thumbsup:
anita: Green room plan: speakers on at 12:30 PT, quick mic check 12:35, tech dry run 12:40. Will send join link and one-pager.
rob: Lighting notes from AV: camera framing (headroom 10-15%), mic gain target -6dB, set key light to 3200K, backfill soft. Also advise speakers to avoid logos on shirts.
ellie: Demo fallback: two options — (1) prerecorded 6:00 clip (high fidelity) (2) run on staging with mock tokens. If live fails, I'll start clip + we do annotated walkthrough. Will upload asset to GDrive.
rehearsal-bot: Reminder: rehearsal scheduled Wed 12:30 PT — meet link https://meet.link/rehearsal — agenda in doc: https://redwood.docs/rehearsal
jason: Pasting run-of-show snippet:
```
12:30 - Green room: mics/cameras
12:45 - Onstage countdown + intro music
13:00 - Host intro (60s)
13:01 - Product overview (3m)
13:04 - Live demo (6m) — engineer Q: start at slide 6
13:10 - Benchmark highlights (4m)
13:14 - Customer story (4m)
13:18 - Q&A (10m)
13:28 - CTA + wrap (2m)
```
maya: Notes — move benchmark highlights earlier if we need to shorten demo. Also, needs a one-liner script for host: keep it conversational.
anita: Speaker cue cards almost done. I'll DM each speaker the 2-line mic check script. Anyone object to mic check lines?
rob: fine from eng side.
jason: For lighting check, please have speakers test background motion (no dancing pets) ;)
ellie: Uploads: clip URL + timestamps for cut points. I'll post in the doc.
maya: Cool. Action items: anita send link + cue cards, ellie upload clip + fallback instructions, jason finalize host script, rob verify AV checklist. Rehearsal-bot — ping 10 mins before green room.
rehearsal-bot: Will ping at 12:20 PT.
maya: Thanks team. Let's be tight. :rocket: 3842004460
